'''Raúl Asencio del Rosario''' (born 13 February 2003) is a Spanish professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)#Centre-back|centre-back]] for {{Spanish football updater|Real Madrid}} club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]].

Asencio joined the Real Madrid academy in 2017 from [[UD Las Palmas|Las Palmas]] and progressed through the club's youth system before playing for [[Real Madrid Castilla]]. He made his first-team debut in 2024 and subsequently established himself as a member of the senior squad, winning the [[FIFA Intercontinental Cup]] with the club.

Asencio has represented [[Spain national under-21 football team|Spain at youth level]].

==Early life==
Born in [[Las Palmas]] in the [[Canary Islands]], Asencio began his youth career at local team Veteranos del Pilar, before joining [[UD Las Palmas|Las Palmas]]. At the age of thirteen, he joined the youth academy of [[La Liga]] club [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elespanol.com/elbernabeu/real-madrid/cantera/20170523/raul-asencio-futuro-asensio-real-madrid/218229042_0.html|first=Marina|last=Cicuéndez|title=Raúl Asencio, el futuro 'Asensio' del Real Madrid|newspaper=[[El Español]]|date=23 May 2017|access-date=23 March 2025|language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mundodeportivo.com/futbol/real-madrid/20230814/1002052260/raul-asencio-marvel-opciones-casa-cubrir-baja-militao.html|first=Ramón|last=Fuentes|title=Raúl Asencio y Marvel, las opciones de casa para cubrir la baja de Militao|newspaper=[[Mundo Deportivo]]|date=14 August 2023|access-date=23 March 2025|language=es}}</ref>

==Club career==
After a short spell at [[RSC Internacional FC|RSC Internacional]], Asencio returned to Real Madrid, and played for their [[Real Madrid Castilla|reserves team]]. There, he was regarded as one of the most important players in the team.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.marca.com/futbol/real-madrid/2023/12/19/6581a1ea46163f4ca18b458e.html|first=Silvia|last=Tamaral|title=Ancelotti recluta a la 'sensación Asencio'|newspaper=[[Marca (newspaper)|Marca]]|date=19 December 2023|access-date=23 March 2025|language=es}}</ref> 

In the [[2024–25 Real Madrid CF season|2024–25 season]], as Real Madrid were short of center-backs following the injury of [[David Alaba]] and [[Éder Militão]], Asencio was brought up to the first team.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://en.as.com/soccer/who-is-raul-asencio-real-madrid-defender-makes-superb-first-team-debut-against-osasuna-n/|title=Who is Raúl Asencio? Real Madrid defender makes superb first-team debut against Osasuna|website=[[Diario AS]]|date=9 November 2024}}</ref> On 9 November 2024, he made his [[La Liga]] debut for Real Madrid, coming on as a substitute in a 4–0 victory against [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://getfootballnewsspain.com/hes-very-important-now-carlo-ancelotti-confirms-real-madrid-youngster-will-stay-with-first-team/|title='He's very important now' – Carlo Ancelotti confirms Real Madrid youngster will stay with first-team|website=Get Football News Spain|date=9 November 2024|access-date=23 March 2025}}</ref> Two weeks later, on 24 November 2024, Asencio made his La Liga debut as a starter for Real Madrid, in a 3–0 victory against [[CD Leganés|Leganés]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Jude Bellingham sends message to Real Madrid teammate Raúl Asencio after win over Leganés|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/jude-bellingham-sends-message-real-150000635.html|website=Yahoo Sports|date=25 November 2024|access-date=11 January 2025}}</ref> On 4 January 2026, he netted his first goal for the club in a 5–1 win over [[Real Betis]].<ref>{{cite web |last=Menzies |first=John |url=https://www.football-espana.net/2026/01/04/real-madrid-real-betis-la-liga-report |title=Gonzalo Garcia inspires Real Madrid to thumping victory in first match of 2026 |publisher=Football Espana |date=4 January 2026 }}</ref>

==International career==
In March 2025, Asencio received his first call up to the [[Spain national football team|Spain national team]] for the [[2024–25 UEFA Nations League A#Quarter-finals|UEFA Nations League quarter-final]] matches against the [[Netherlands national football team|Netherlands]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Real Madrid centre-back Raul Asencio receives first Spain call-up|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/6203165/2025/03/14/raul-asencio-spain-squad-real-madrid/|publisher=The Athletic|date=14 March 2025}}</ref>

==Style of play==
Asencio mainly operates as a center-back and has been described as "decisive with the ball and with great physical conditioning".<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.relevo.com/futbol/primera-rfef/castilla-raul-20230627162632-nt.html|first1=Jorge C.|last1=Picón|first2=June|last2=Lavín|title=El Castilla del futuro: puerta abierta a Dotor, Arribas esperará al primer equipo y dos renovaciones complejas|website=[[Relevo]]|date=28 June 2023|access-date=23 March 2025|language=es}}</ref>

==Controversies==
===Sexual video controversy===
In September 2023, Asencio and three other [[Real Madrid Castilla]] and [[Real Madrid C]] players – [[Ferran Ruiz]], Juan Rodríguez and Andrés Garcia – were arrested over allegations that two of the players had filmed and distributed a video of a sexual encounter involving an adult woman and a minor who had not consented to the recording.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Rai |first=Guillermo |date=14 September 2023 |title=Three Real Madrid academy players arrested after allegedly sharing sexual video featuring a minor |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4863831/2023/09/14/real-madrid-youth-players-arrested/ |access-date=15 May 2025 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref> Asencio was alleged to have accessed the video and to have distributed it to another person. In January 2025, Spanish sports website [[Relevo]] reported that Asencio was no longer under investigation in the case.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.relevo.com/futbol/verdad-asencio-canteranos-investigado-solo-20250110144031-nt.html|first1=Jorge C.|last1=Picón|first2=Gonzalo|last2=Cabeza|title=La verdad de Asencio en el caso canteranos: ya no está siendo investigado y sólo sigue en la instrucción como testigo|website=[[Relevo]]|date=10 January 2025|access-date=23 March 2025|language=es}}</ref> However, in February 2025, an appeal by Asencio's lawyers to end the investigation was rejected by a court in [[Gran Canaria]], and Asencio remains indicted on child pornography charges.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.co.uk/football/story/_/id/43794085/court-rejects-appeal-madrid-raul-asencio-child-sexual-abuse-investigation|first1=Alex|last1=Kirkland|first2=Rodrigo|last2=Faez|title=Court rejects appeal by Madrid's Raúl Asencio in investigation of child sex abuse video|publisher=[[ESPN]]|date=11 February 2025|access-date=23 March 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/tomsanderson/2025/02/11/real-madrid-star-remains-accused-in-child-pornography-case-reports-el-confidencial/|first=Tom|last=Sanderson|title=Real Madrid Star Remains Under Investigation In Child Pornography Case, Reports El Confidencial|magazine=[[Forbes]]|date=11 February 2025|access-date=23 March 2025}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.elconfidencial.com/espana/2025-02-11/la-justicia-mantiene-imputado-al-central-del-madrid-asencio-por-presunta-pornografia-infantil_4062129/|first=Alejandro|last=Requeijo|title=La Justicia mantiene imputado al central del Madrid Asencio por presunta pornografía infantil|newspaper=[[El Confidencial]]|date=11 February 2025|access-date=23 March 2025|language=es}}</ref>

In May 2025, the investigating court of [[San Bartolomé de Tirajana]] confirmed that criminal proceedings would advance against Raul Asencio and three of his former Real Madrid reserve teammates (Ferran Ruiz, Juan Rodriguez, and Andrés Garcia), paving the way for a trial. They are accused of recording and subsequently distributing, in June 2023, sexually explicit videos of a 16-year-old minor without her [[consent]]. The alleged incident occurred in a nightclub in the [[Canary Islands]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Jones |first=Sam |date=15 May 2025 |title=Real Madrid's Raúl Asencio could face trial over alleged sharing of explicit video |url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2025/may/15/real-madrid-raul-asencio-could-face-trial-over-alleged-sharing-of-explicit-video |access-date=15 May 2025 |work=The Guardian |language=en-GB |issn=0261-3077}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last1=Cortegana |first1=Mario |last2=Rai |first2=Guillermo |date=15 May 2025 |title=Real Madrid's Raul Asencio could face criminal proceedings for allegedly sharing sex tape of a minor |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/6356571/2025/05/14/real-madrid-raul-asencio-investigation/ |access-date=15 May 2025 |work=The New York Times |language=en-US |issn=0362-4331}}</ref> The formal charges include "disclosure of secrets without consent and [[violation of privacy]]," "distribution and transmission to third parties of videos without warning or consent of the injured parties," and "use of minors for [[Pornography|pornographic]] purposes and possession of [[child pornography]] material."<ref>{{Cite web |title=Raul Asencio et trois anciens coéquipiers officiellement poursuivis pour enregistrement et diffusion de contenu pédopornographique |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/Actualites/Raul-asencio-et-trois-anciens-coequipiers-officiellement-poursuivis-pour-enregistrement-et-diffusion-de-contenu-pedopornographique/1561779 |access-date=15 May 2025 |website=L'Équipe |language=fr}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=14 May 2025 |title=Liga : Raul Asencio et trois anciens joueurs du Real Madrid poursuivis pour une vidéo à caractère sexuel avec une mineure |url=https://www.lefigaro.fr/sports/football/espagne/liga-raul-asencio-et-trois-autres-anciens-joueurs-du-real-madrid-poursuivis-pour-une-video-a-caractere-sexuel-avec-une-mineure-20250514 |access-date=15 May 2025 |website=Le Figaro |language=fr}}</ref> Raul Asencio was later acquitted of these charges in September 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |date=September 3, 2026 |title=Real Madrid's Raul Asencio acquitted in sex-tape sharing case |url=https://www.aljazeera.com/sports/2026/9/3/real-madrids-raul-asencio-acquitted-in-sex-tape-sharing-case |access-date=September 3, 2026 |website=Al Jazeera}}</ref>

===Drunk driving conviction===
In August 2026, Asencio was convicted of a road safety offence after being stopped at a traffic checkpoint in San Bartolomé de Tirajana, [[Gran Canaria]], on 16 August while [[Drunk driving|driving under the influence of alcohol]]. He recorded [[Alcohol (drug)|alcohol]] levels of 0.90 and 0.88 mg/l in two [[breathalyzer]] tests, exceeding Spain's legal threshold for a criminal offence. Asencio admitted the offence during an expedited trial on 19 August and accepted a sentence of a €14,400 fine and an eight-month driving ban. He also expressed remorse for the incident.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.abc.es/deportes/real-madrid/raul-asencio-condenado-conducir-bebido-gran-canaria-20260902103435-nt.html|first=Miguel|last=Zarza|title=Raúl Asencio, condenado por conducir bebido en Gran Canaria|newspaper=[[ABC (newspaper)|ABC]]|date=2 September 2026|access-date=3 September 2026|language=es}}</ref>
